# codebase-agent-os-bridge

Bridge layer between the agent-OS surface and underlying runtimes. Worth
inspecting when designing the harness/driver registry.

## Stack & contents

Node.js / Express-style server. ~17 files under `code/agent-os-bridge/routes/`. Routes for: agents, dispatch, feed, handoffs, inbox, missions, proposals, tasks, wiki.

## Why this is here

This branch is a useful **inventory of HTTP surfaces** an Agent OS gateway tends to need — even if EMA replaces the Node server with the Elixir daemon, the route names map almost 1:1 onto control-plane endpoints.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-bridge:code/agent-os-bridge/server.js
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-bridge:code/agent-os-bridge/routes/agents.js
```
